Brilliant interview by @leighsales with @TaranaBurke tonight on @abc730. If you missed it, watch it. 

And can’t wait to read her new memoir, Unbound #MeToo #abc730

Important new #climate case filed in Australia today by leaders from the Torres Strait against government inaction on #climatechange

Proud that @GrataFund is supporting this case & all the hard work that has gone into putting it together

#ClimateAction Get involved & donate:

#NetZero by 2050 is not enough to save the Torres Strait from the #climatecrisis. Proud that @GrataFund is supporting Paul and Pabai to bring this case to protect their country and community 

Donate and support:
https://t.co/aKwBGwwhUz #ClimateCaseAU #COP26 #auslaw

This just gave me the best laugh I’ve had in days, thanks to @thejuicemedia

And it’s hard to laugh about something as depressing and infuriating as Australia’s climate “policy” #COP26 #auspol #climatecrisis

A must read essay of stories from across the #Pacific by my brilliant friend & colleague @julian_aguon - on why the world must turn its attention to the islands that are at the forefront of the #climatecrisis: https://t.co/1gZbUFpRSw @TheAtlantic 

#COP26 #ClimateAction

Proud to be representing Leetona Dungay in her @UNHumanRights complaint about her son’s death in custody and Australia’s failure to end impunity for Aboriginal deaths in custody - with the brilliant @LarissaBehrendt, instructed by @NJP_Au #BlackLivesMatter @DoughtyStIntl

This is so important, as is the fact that they carry the #WestPapua flag among fellow Pacific nations. 

Indonesia continues to unlawfully occupy West Papua & destroy its rainforests - among the most important in the world, which we need to protect to stop the #climatecrisis

Celebrating #WestPapua’s national day in Australia with my brother Alpheus. We met 20 yrs ago when he risked his life to protect @BennyWenda’s family. Legend.

He released a song today - in Lani, his tribal language: #BlackLivesMatter in West Papua https://t.co/8DQH7iVAG5 https://t.co/mlW23u6A5x
